title: Indus floodplain corridor
description: Real satellite comparison during the August 2022 Pakistan floods. Water-related visual changes are evident around the Indus floodplain. This is contextual source information, not a classification produced by TerraLens.
caveats: Both dates contain clouds and cloud shadows; these must not be interpreted automatically as terrain change.
False-color rendered imagery, not raw spectral reflectance.
VIIRS regional-scale visualization cannot establish road passability or individual building damage.
georeferencing: Bounds derived exactly from pixel crop of the original EPSG:4326 WMS raster, using its declared bounds and dimensions.
alignment: Both dates rendered by GIBS to identical projection, bounds, and dimensions; visually checked stable terrain. No independent subpixel registration validation.

files.preparation: Exact integer pixel crop [100, 250, 600, 800] from original 1000x1000 PNG. Converted to RGB JPEG quality 94. No rescaling, overlays, or generative edits.
